# FixMyFile
> Free browser-based tools for PDFs, images, OCR, documents, Indian form uploads, and calculators. Files are processed on your device for most tools; nothing is uploaded for client-side tools.
Site: https://fixmyfile.co.in/
Sitemap: https://fixmyfile.co.in/sitemap.xml

## Hubs
- [All tools](https://fixmyfile.co.in/): Full catalog of free file tools.
- [PDF Tools](https://fixmyfile.co.in/category/pdf-tools): Free online PDF tools that work in your browser. Merge, split, compress, rotate, sign, protect and convert PDFs to Word, Excel, images and more. No uploads, no sign-up.
- [Image Tools](https://fixmyfile.co.in/category/image-tools): Free browser-based image tools. Resize to an exact KB size for form uploads, compress, crop, convert PNG/JPG/WebP, remove backgrounds, make passport photos and merge images. No uploads.
- [Form Upload Tools](https://fixmyfile.co.in/category/form-upload-tools): Resize photos and signatures to exact KB limits for exam, job, passport and government portal uploads. Make passport photos, compress PDFs for forms. Free, private, no upload.
- [OCR & Text Extraction](https://fixmyfile.co.in/category/ocr-tools): Free OCR tools to extract text from images, scanned PDFs, receipts and tables. Supports 50+ languages. Runs in your browser — no uploads, no sign-up.
- [Documents & Text](https://fixmyfile.co.in/category/document-tools): Free document and text tools: format documents, convert Word and PowerPoint, count words, change case, find and replace, compare text and remove duplicates. Browser-based, no upload.
- [Calculators](https://fixmyfile.co.in/category/calculators): Free financial calculators for India: EMI calculator with loan affordability, GST calculator for 5/12/18/28% and SIP mutual fund returns. Instant, in your browser.
- [Developer Tools](https://fixmyfile.co.in/category/developer-tools): Free developer utilities: JSON formatter, Base64 encode/decode, URL encoder, color picker, QR code generator and scanner, regex tester and more. Browser-based, no upload.
- [Blog](https://fixmyfile.co.in/blog): How-to guides for PDFs, images, OCR and form uploads.

## Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/merge): Combine multiple PDFs into one document
- [Split PDF](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/split): Split a PDF into multiple files
- [Compress PDF](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/compress): Reduce PDF file size
- [Extract Pages](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/extract-pages): Extract specific pages from a PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/rotate): Rotate pages in any direction
- [Watermark PDF](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/watermark): Add text or image watermarks
- [Add Page Numbers](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/page-numbers): Insert page numbers on every page
- [Crop PDF](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/crop-pdf): Crop page margins and whitespace

- [Unlock PDF](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove password protection
- [PDF to Image](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/pdf-to-image): Convert PDF pages to PNG or JPG
- [PDF to Word](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF to editable .docx document
- [PDF to Excel](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables from PDF as CSV
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://fixmyfile.co.in/tools/pdf-to-ppt): Convert PDF pages to PPTX slides
